title: ExtraBan
description: This mod is create for server.Operators can ban some players more easy!
body:
This plugin is create for server.Operators can ban some players more easy!
Like this command:
/e-ban {banname} {bantime(mins)} {banreason}
(This command will ban a player,and add this player's name in banplayers scare.)
And this command:
/e-ban set enter "kick {bannedplayername}"
(This command will set kick banned player when banned player enter the game.
You also can use /e-ban set leave "{somecommand}".Don't edit the "{bannedplayername}",because It's a tag for plugins.)

And if you want to unban a player,you need use/e-pardon {pardonname}.
(Don't use /pardon {pardonname}.Because if you use this command,player name still in banplayers scare.Enter/leave command still will run the command.)

This plugin create by [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/).MCreator Plugin made by [cdc](https://github.com/cdc123456789).

You can use,share and edit this plugins,but I can't provide the MCreator WorkSpace.I'm very sorry.

You needs edit the {sometext} to you needs text,if I said don't need do that.
